rows.grounds: compound sūkṣma + cūrṇa; accusative object of kṛtvā

items.question: What alternative substances may be used to make the powder that breaks the tālayantra?
premises: fine powder is made from that
iron slag is offered as an alternative
items.inference: The verse lists alternative materials for preparing the powder used against the tālayantra.
uncertainties: the exact referent of tāṃ is not explicit in this excerpt
items.plain_english: But making that into fine powder, or iron slag, or...
